answer: Sybil resistance in AI economies can leverage Proof-of-Resource, mandating agents stake unique, verifiable computational assets. These assets, akin to 'crystal' structures, represent significant, non-fungible processing commitments. This creates a clear economic 'ridge', requiring attackers to accrue substantial real-world computational power to forge multiple identities. The foundational 'umber' cost of acquiring or generating such scarce, verifiable resources ensures each distinct agent identity represents a prohibitively expensive investment, preventing trivial replication.
